dedupe_keys.name: grid level residential building stock model of mainland china floor area and replacement value

description: This dataset gives a grid-level residential building stock model of mainland China in terms of floor area and replacement value, with comparisons against census records and part of the modelling code. It was published on Zenodo on 7 April 2021 by Danhua Xin of the Southern University of Science and Technology, James Daniell and Friedemann Wenzel of the Karlsruhe Institute of Technology and Hing-Ho Tsang of Swinburne University of Technology, as supplementary data for Xin et al. (2021). Files are two ArcGIS layer packages (population with floor area, and population with value), provincial comparisons of modelled and census floor area, fixed asset investment statistics for 2004 to 2014, a MATLAB building discretisation script and a readme. Coverage: mainland China. Access: Zenodo, about 260 MB in total. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: modelled values; the layer packages need ArcGIS or conversion. Simulation uses: residential exposure for earthquake and other hazard loss models in China. Related records: OpenBuildingMap and the Bauhaus der Erde residential floor area data.
